proposal.summary: redis-py before 4.5.3 leaves a connection open after canceling an async Redis command, potentially sending response data to the client of an unrelated request.
proposal.cwe_quote: leaves a connection open after canceling an async Redis command at an inopportune time, and can send response data to the client of an unrelated request in an off-by-one manner.

AV.quote: leaves a connection open after canceling an async Redis command at an inopportune time

C.quote: can send response data to the client of an unrelated request in an off-by-one manner.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Investigate the impact of the vulnerability on your deployment and consider upgrading to redis-py version 4.5.3 or later.

evidence_quotes.claim: The product version affected by the vulnerability.

evidence_quotes.quote: leaves a connection open after canceling an async Redis command at an inopportune time, and can send response data to the client of an unrelated request in an off-by-one manner.
